layer_map.what: NEW reusable `CodeEditor`: three-layer overlay (gutter + aria-hidden `<pre>` + transparent `<textarea>`, single scroll source) owning `compose()`+100ms debounce+colored snapshot, `gutterDivs`/`tokenSpans` memos, onScroll sync; scroll-reset + `setColored(null)` invalidation AND the compose-debounce re-arm keyed on the **`resetKey` prop** (verbatim port of BodyEditor.tsx:104-128, parameterized off `activeTabId`→`resetKey`); local `--code-line-h` drives all three grid row heights

`BodyEditor` consumes `<CodeEditor resetKey={activeTabId} value/lang/onChange/validVars>` in the raw slot (296-327); inline overlay markup + editor state/memos + BOTH `activeTabId`-keyed effects (reset 104-114, re-arm 122-128) + code-area CSS removed — the reset now fires via `resetKey={activeTabId}`; toolbar/radiogroup/lang-pill/mount-all panels retained
`jsonTokens.compose()` reused UNCHANGED (import only — AC-11 + JSON.parse detector); `varTokens.isMissingVar`, `envVars` unchanged

NEW `CodeEditor.ct.tsx`: relocated AC-23 live/debounced guard + row-height equality (textarea/pre/gutter all = 20.625px) via computed-style channel; the AC-6 reset contracts (identical-body re-arm + scroll-bleed reset) driven via `resetKey`; full styling context (tokens.css import + data-mstyle + `.code-editor` scope)
`BodyEditor` CT/stories retain integration + `body-*` testid assertions + the AC-6 `resetKey={activeTabId}` wiring assertion; fidelity/alignment ACs move to CodeEditor CT

key_design_decisions.why: §2.2 domain-agnostic → molecules; lets BodyEditor (and a future response-body organism) consume it downward with no sibling-organism import (AC-9, AC-15). Follows Dropdown/Tabs/Divider precedent — not a departure.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: `organisms/` (forces sibling-organism import — §2.2 violation); `atoms/` (owns compose+debounce+state, not a primitive)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: ONE local CSS var `--code-line-h = calc(12.5px * 1.65)` = 20.625px scoped to `CodeEditor.css`, driving textarea + pre + gutter row heights
key_design_decisions.why: Single-sources the duplicated literal → DRY (AC-12); absolute px keeps the gutter off the `1.65em` trap that drifts against the 11.5px gutter font (AC-13, AC-20, AC-21). Component-internal metric → local var, NOT `tokens.json` (§6).
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: `tokens.json` global token (OOS §6); `1.65em` on gutter (the original bug); per-element repeated literals (breaks DRY + AC-13)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Self-contained `CodeEditor`, props `{value, lang, onChange, validVars, resetKey?}`; owns `compose()`+debounce(100ms)+colored snapshot; reuses `jsonTokens.compose()` UNCHANGED
key_design_decisions.why: §3.6 reuse-not-reimplement (AC-11); self-contained controlled-molecule matches Tabs precedent (AC-14 — the 4 core props still mount stand-alone; `resetKey` is additive/optional). `compose()` JSON.parse malformed-degrade detector untouched (AC-17). `colored` nullable preserved — `null` plain-degrade exercised by AC-2/AC-17 and by AC-6 invalidation; `{snapshot,tokens}` colored by AC-11/AC-23.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Passing composed tokens in as a prop (leaks internals, defeats reuse); forking/editing `compose()` (regresses AC-11 + AC-17 detector)

key_design_decisions.why: number`; CodeEditor keys its scroll-reset + `setColored(null)` effect AND its compose-debounce re-arm effect on `resetKey` (verbatim port of BodyEditor.tsx:104-128). BodyEditor passes `resetKey={activeTabId}`
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: AC-6 (reset scroll + invalidate colored on tab switch) needs a consumer-driven signal: `value`+`lang` are identical when two tabs hold the same raw body, so a props-only `{value,lang,onChange,validVars}` molecule gets no trigger (grill F-001). A generic `resetKey` keeps CodeEditor domain-agnostic (§2.2 — no tabsStore/activeTabId awareness). Restores BodyEditor.ct.tsx:769 (identical-body re-arm) + :811 (scroll-bleed reset). Not a DEPARTURE — establishes the standard React reset-on-change idiom (no prior pattern for signalling an extracted editor).

key_design_decisions.why: Zero CT churn; existing BodyEditor CTs stay green (AC-8)
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Renaming to `code-*` (churns every existing CT, breaks AC-8)

file_impact.what_changes: Self-contained overlay editor: gutter/pre/textarea + compose+debounce+colored state + scroll-sync + memos; props `{value, lang, onChange, validVars, resetKey?}`; scroll-reset + `setColored(null)` + debounce re-arm keyed on `resetKey`; `body-*` testids
Code-area CSS moved from BodyEditor.css; `--code-line-h` var drives textarea/pre/gutter row heights; tk-* + overlay + focus rules

Fidelity + alignment CT (row-height equality all three = 20.625px, AC-23 live/debounced guard, tk-* colors via computed-style channel); AC-6 reset via `resetKey` change (identical-body re-arm + scroll-bleed reset); full styling-context fixture

Remove inline raw-slot overlay markup + editor state/memos + BOTH `activeTabId`-keyed effects (104-114, 122-128); render `<CodeEditor resetKey={activeTabId} …>` in the raw slot; keep toolbar/radiogroup/lang-pill/mount-all
Remove relocated code-area/overlay rules; keep toolbar/radio/lang-pill styles
Move fidelity/alignment ACs to CodeEditor CT; retain integration + `body-*` testid assertions + the `resetKey={activeTabId}` wiring assertion (AC-6 at the org level)
Adjust fixtures if raw-slot markup structure changes (testids preserved)

doc_impact.what_changes: Add `CodeEditor` to the molecules roster (with the `resetKey` reset-on-change signal); note BodyEditor as its consumer
Note CodeEditor as a reusable molecule + the consume relationship + the `resetKey` idiom (AC-18)

risks.risk: Overlay pixel-grid desync (transparent textarea over highlighted pre) during the move
risks.mitigation: Move padding/box-sizing/font verbatim; assert textarea/pre/gutter row-height equality + tk-* colors via the live-renderer computed-style channel (fidelityAssert); UNVERIFIED-not-PASS when channel absent

risks.risk: `resetKey` reset+re-arm ported imperfectly, stranding AC-6 (identical-body tabs)
risks.mitigation: Port BodyEditor.tsx:104-128 verbatim, swapping only the `activeTabId` dep → `resetKey`; keep BOTH effects (reset AND debounce re-arm); regression-guarded by BodyEditor.ct.tsx:769 + :811 relocated to the CodeEditor CT

risks.risk: CodeEditor CT green-but-wrong because the fixture omits full styling context
risks.mitigation: CT fixture reproduces tokens.css import + data-mstyle + `.code-editor`/production className scope (alias-trap lesson)

risks.risk: Static/CT fidelity reports CLEAN yet layout drift persists
risks.mitigation: DOM-verify gutter, pre, AND textarea computed row heights are all equal, not just the gutter guard

risks.risk: `jsonTokens.compose()` accidentally edited (would regress AC-11 reuse + AC-17 JSON.parse detector)
risks.mitigation: Reuse by import only; compose() stays byte-unchanged — do NOT touch

risks.risk: CodeEditor back-imports a sibling organism / uses a deep relative path / gains tabsStore awareness
risks.mitigation: CodeEditor imports only lib/ + atoms via `@renderer`, never `organisms/`; `resetKey` stays an opaque scalar (§2.2, §2.3)

dependencies: None. No packages to install, no services, no env vars. React 19, `@playwright/experimental-ct-react`, and `jsonTokens` are all already in the stack.
